See the Town of Port Royal, Paris Island, and Port Royal Sound along the way as well as Dolphins, Sea Turtles, Sea Birds, and other wildlife. I will literally fish for anything that will eat and show you a great time doing it. I try to customize my charters to fit your hopes and leave you happy at the end of the day. services.name: 7 Hour Private Charter
services.desc: Hop aboard Tallboy Fishing Charters with a local Expert! Private Charter: $1,200 Up to 4 Passengers Full Day Offshore Charter Full day fishing charters offer the chance to get to blue water and fantastic fish. If you truly want to catch a lot of quality table fare you might consider spending a full day on the water with us. Full day fishing charters are spent between 15 and 40 Miles offshore depending on sea conditions, and target a wide range of fish including Cobia, King Mackerel, Amberjack, Sea Bass, Snapper, Grouper, Triggerfish, Spadefish, and occassionally Dolphin (Mahi Mahi), Starting at $1,200 · Up to 4 Passengers · Live Bait and Bottom Fishing
